profile.name: AegeanWorks
profile.description: AegeanWorks - an independent studio building local-first AI systems, cognitive tooling, and computational research.

repositories.name: Aegean-Licensing
repositories.description: The Aegean License family (AL, AGL and ASL 1.1) and the Aegean Commercial License: canonical texts, policies, commercial templates and certificate verification tooling for AegeanWorks projects.

repositories.name: Aegean-Reforge
repositories.description: Archived: integrated into AIKit. Progressive, evidence-backed Git history auditing and safe repair now ships as AIKit's reforge/ package plus reforge.py; the archived repository keeps its history and tags. Free for personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: AIKit
repositories.description: Crash-resilient governance and delivery gates for AI coding agents: versioned task ledger, commit-level verification, secret scanning and per-project gates. Free for personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Aldervale
repositories.description: A 2.5D medieval RPG drawn in tiny ASCII cells: low-poly 3D models baked into shaded sprites, voxel terrain, fog, day and night, water, quests, combat, loot, shops and saves. Python standard library only: no dependencies, no assets, no build step. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Assay
repositories.description: Tamper-evident audit evidence for AI agents: a local-first hash-chained ledger, policy review, and offline-verifiable evidence packs. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Chronos
repositories.description: A lightweight, local-first focus and session orchestrator for developers: track deep-work sessions, micro-milestones and interruptions, and get productivity insights. Python standard library only. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Crypt-Crawler
repositories.description: A tactical turn-based dungeon crawler for the browser: procedural levels, inventory, combat and headless browser inspection. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Cyberpulse
repositories.description: A retro-cyberpunk terminal hacking game built on behavioral psychology: procedural puzzle nodes, ICE defenses, push-your-luck extraction, persistent progression and a five-act campaign. Python standard library only. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Fluid-Universe
repositories.description: Falsification-first research codebase testing a Z3 circulant origin of the Koide lepton relation, with a separately labelled nematic-fluid UV speculation. Free non-commercial research under ASL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Fold
repositories.description: A 4x4 tile-merge puzzle you run on your own machine: one Python process, a browser page, no dependencies, no account and no network calls. Slide, merge and chase 2048; the server owns the rules and the browser only renders. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Gauge
repositories.description: A zero-dependency terminal ruler for numeric series: read numbers from arguments, a file or a pipe and draw a sparkline, signed bars, a histogram, a box plot or a statistics block. stats --json feeds other tools. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Lacon
repositories.description: An AI that thinks in as few letters as possible, recursively over a long context: its own alphabet, budget, thinker and recursive engine. No network, no API key, no model weights; the core is standard library only. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Lattice
repositories.description: A provenance-first research knowledge graph for humans and AI agents. Local-first, SQLite-backed and standard library only. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: MemoryReconstruction
repositories.description: A top-down action roguelike about rebuilding a shattered world from lost memories: expeditions from the Sanctuary through sixteen procedurally generated sections, built with TypeScript and PixiJS. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Mnemo
repositories.description: A dependency-free, local-first spaced-repetition flashcard CLI: study each card on the day the SM-2 algorithm says it is due, and keep everything in one readable JSON file on your machine. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Muse
repositories.description: Prompt-driven AI music creation with an automated listener that scores how well each track fits its theme, available as a CLI and a Python library. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: N1-Engine
repositories.description: A local-first, privacy-focused platform for rigorous N-of-1 self-experimentation: apply scientific statistics to your own life data, on your own machine. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeuralBeat
repositories.description: A local-first neuro-acoustic desktop app that generates mathematically accurate binaural, monaural and isochronic tones for focus, meditation, relaxation and sleep. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeuralDeck
repositories.description: An offline desktop app that turns PDFs, Word files and other documents into high-quality Anki flashcards with a local LLM, with smart deck matching, AI editing and direct Anki sync. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeuroCore
repositories.description: A self-hosted, modular AI agent framework for persistent, tool-using autonomous systems: workflows, long-term memory, RAG and a plugin architecture in one platform. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeurologyClinicTemplates-TR
repositories.description: Standardized Turkish anamnesis (patient history) templates for common neurology complaints, helping neurologists, residents and medical students document assessments completely and systematically. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NeuroOptic
repositories.description: A research-grade visual oscillator for brainwave entrainment: configurable 1-120 Hz frequencies, hardware-aware safety limits and drift-free phase accumulation. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NobetWizard
repositories.description: An automated duty roster generator built with Streamlit: fair monthly schedules under constraints such as gender, rest days and availability, with Excel and PDF export, in English and Turkish. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: NoMoreClutter
repositories.description: An AI desktop app that organizes your files with large language models: it analyzes, categorizes and renames them with descriptive names, and works with local LLMs. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Orrery
repositories.description: An N-body gravitational sandbox for the terminal or the browser: nine curated worlds, a symplectic integrator, optional relativity and collisions, live energy diagnostics, orbit trails and CSV/JSON export. Standard library only. Free non-commercial research under ASL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Pebble
repositories.description: A tiny, dependency-free scripting language: lexer, parser, tree-walking evaluator and REPL. Built as an AIKit evaluation project, where the process is under test as much as the code. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Photo-Harbor
repositories.description: A self-hosted photo server for Windows: an iPhone sends new photos over home Wi-Fi through Apple Shortcuts, with no app to install, verified-hash cleanup and a gallery. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: PNN
repositories.description: Oral, blood-brain barrier-penetrant agents that soften hypothalamic perineuronal nets to restore insulin signaling in obesity: research notes, data and computational analyses. Free non-commercial research under ASL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Primordia
repositories.description: A zero-dependency evolution sandbox: seed a biosphere, run its clock, and watch genomes vary, compete and speciate. Every run replays exactly from its seed, and a fossil record keeps its history. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Prism-Relay
repositories.description: A neon light-routing puzzle game: rotate mirrors and splitters, fold beams through portals, and charge every receiver across three episodes. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Research-Engine
repositories.description: A falsification-first research engine that turns questions into provenance-backed claims, executable kill tests, and auditable verdicts.

repositories.name: Tally
repositories.description: A dependency-free, local-first expense ledger for the terminal: record what you spend, list it and see where the money went, all in one readable JSON file on your machine. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Tempo
repositories.description: A focus timer you run on your own machine: one Python process, a browser page, no dependencies, no account and no network calls. Focus and break phases alternate, and every fourth break is a long one. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: UI-Sandbox
repositories.description: A small React + Vite surface for exercising AIKit's bounded UI guard: one screen, token-driven theming, and a labelled control for every interaction. Free personal use under AL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.

repositories.name: Voidfarer
repositories.description: A zero-dependency space flight and exploration simulator with an autonomous deep-space fleet, a procedural galaxy and a Windows cockpit: route reactor power, board derelicts, scoop fuel, command drones, fight and trade. Free personal play under AGL-1.1; commercial use under ACL-1.0.
